note: 你拿这个 odd as a hand-over; 这个给你/你拿着 more natural. Cue copies translation.
Odd question to ask without context. Cue copies translation.
我不想喝 is blunt rather than polite, but fine between friends.
你到这里了 is unnatural; would say 你到了. English also awkward. Cue copies translation.
Cue copies awkward English translation; 等等 second syllable usually neutral (děngdeng).
到不了 is dào bu liǎo, not bù le. English "reach there" awkward ("can't get there").
Bare 你很快 with no context is odd (你跑得很快/你好快).
你拿什么 is vague without context. Cue copies translation.
Asking a friend if they have money is a bit blunt; missing question mark. 没有 appears via A-not-A 有没有.
Offer with 我帮你做一下吗 is unnatural; would be 要不要我帮你？/我帮你吧. Missing question mark.
English is a fragment ("Few people.") for a full sentence; cue copies it.
"Do you drink?" suggests habitual drinking; 你喝吗 is more "Want some?". Cue copies translation.
我帮你做东西吗 is unnatural as an offer; cue "help with something" does not elicit 做. Missing question mark.
我帮你拿一下吗 is unnatural as an offer (要不要我帮你拿？/我帮你拿吧).
Cue says "really like" but answer has no intensifier (很/真).
Bare 那个地方大 without 很 sounds contrastive; cue says "the place you are looking for", text says "that place".
Fragment 一点吗？ with no context; cue copies translation.
English "I want" is incomplete (means "I want it/one"); cue copies it.
Elliptical 不小 with no context; cue copies translation.
你做什么 reads as "what do you do (job)/what will you do"; "What are you doing?" is 你在做什么. Cue copies translation.
你想要吃一点什么 awkward (你想吃点什么); English "eat a little of" is a literal mistranslation; cue is the English verbatim.
Cue is the translation verbatim; 要 here is intention/future rather than plain "want".
你做得慢 without 很 sounds contrastive/incomplete. Cue copies translation.
As an invitation, bare 你跟我一起去。 sounds like an order; needs 吧 or 要不要. English "go with me together" awkward.
"Can this be a little slower?" is vague/odd. Cue copies translation.
回 without object/complement (回来/回家) is marginal. Cue copies translation.
你知道的太多了 is a jokey "you know too much" (meme/mock threat), not an expression of surprise as the cue asks.
Vague without context; cue copies translation.
Bare 很快 with no context (also often means "soon"); cue copies translation.
"Are you waiting for me?" is 你在等我吗; 你等我吗 reads as "Will you wait for me?". Cue copies translation.
你现在在做什么 more natural for "What are you doing now?". Cue copies translation.
我家很小 slightly more natural than 我的家很小.
这个太好了 means "This is great!", not "too good". Cue copies the misleading English.
你今天很好 does not mean "you look good today" (你今天很好看/气色很好).
For dietary ability 你能吃这个吗 is more natural; 可以 suggests permission.
我工作很少 is awkward (我工作不多); sentence makes no offer of help as the cue asks.
Subjectless 一起买吗 is clipped; 我们一起买吧/要不要一起买 more natural. Cue copies translation.
你很好 out of context is vague ("you're nice/kind"). Cue copies translation.
我喜欢这个多一点 is a dialectal/calque order; standard is 我更/比较喜欢这个.
Cue copies awkward English translation ("You, a little faster").
得 is neutral-tone de, not dé.
我懂那个 is odd; cue "confirm you understand" leads to 我懂了/我明白了, not 那个.
我不要去 is blunt/insistent; cue asks for a polite refusal (我不太想去).
回来 written as two syllables huí lái (usually huílai); minor.
"Where are you going?" is 你去哪里; 你到哪里 is more "where have you got to". Cue copies translation.
我用钱 "I use money" is meaningless out of context. Cue copies translation.
快 here is 快…了 "about to/soon", not "fast". Cue copies translation.
Clipped (怎么做才能快一点？); missing question mark.
你做什么 reads as "what do you do/what will you do"; "What are you doing?" is 你在做什么. Cue copies translation.
你很好 out of context is vague ("you're nice/kind"). Cue copies translation.
我钱很少 awkward; 我没什么钱/我钱不多 more natural.
Cue is the English verbatim; pinyin splits words into syllables (xiàn zài kě yǐ).
Missing 是: should be 这是什么/这个是什么. Cue copies translation.
我要钱 sounds like demanding money; "need" would be 我需要钱/我没钱了.
你现在在做什么 more natural for "what are you doing now"; missing question mark.
Subjectless 哪里找 and 好吃的地方 are awkward; 哪里有好吃的餐厅？ more natural.
Word order: "you can take that" is 你可以拿那个; 你拿那个可以 is awkward.
今天好 is unnatural for "today works"; 今天可以/今天行. Cue copies translation.
Vague without context; cue copies translation.
English "very tasty to drink" awkward but accurate.
Duration needs 多久, not 多少; half-width "?"; cue says "how long THEY have to wait" but translation is "I".
Cue introduces a vendor, outside the two-friends setting; fine otherwise.
Cue asks for a polite refusal, but the sentence only states it is too small.
你慢吗 "Are you slow?" is odd and pointless. Cue copies translation.
大 used only inside 多大 (age). Cue copies translation.
多 used only inside 多少; missing question mark.
大一点 means "a bit bigger" (comparative); "a little big" is 有点大, which is what the cue elicits.
"I used money to buy it" is a pointless statement.
Cue copies awkward English translation ("You, a little faster").
"I held this yesterday" is an odd thing to say; cue does not mention yesterday.
Bare 我慢 is unnatural (我很慢/我比较慢). Cue copies translation.
Cue is the translation verbatim; 我喜欢你 carries romantic connotation.
你到哪里了 means "Where are you now (en route)?", not "Where have you arrived?"; missing question mark.
"Do you drink?" suggests habitual drinking; 你喝吗 is more "Want some?". Cue copies translation.
Cue "tell your friend you understand" leads to 我懂了/我明白, not 你.
这个我不要 is a blunt refusal; cue asks for a polite one (不用了，谢谢).
很 inside a 吗 question is odd (这个东西好吗/好不好); missing question mark.
Cue is the translation verbatim; 我喜欢你 carries romantic connotation.
你跟谁一起来的？ more natural.
Vague without context; cue copies translation.
我真的很喜欢 more natural.
今天好 is unnatural for "today works"; 今天可以/今天行. Cue copies translation.
我想找你 means "I want to come see you/look you up", not "find you"; cue repeats the wrong sense.
English "This can." is wrong ("This is fine/works"); cue copies it.
Elliptical 不少 means "quite a lot"; "It's not few" is misleading; cue copies it.
我慢一点 slightly odd as a promise (我会慢一点). Cue copies translation.
回 without object/complement (回来/回家) is marginal. Cue copies translation.
我这里 implies "at my place"; 我在这里没有朋友 fits the meaning.
